We know one student got 95%.  
Another student got 3 wrong out of 40, so that student got 40 − 3 = 37 correct.  
37 out of 40 as a percentage: (37/40) × 100 = 92.5%.  

The highest score so far is 95%.  
To beat that, Sierra needs more than 95%.  
If the test is out of 40 questions, 95% of 40 = 0.95 × 40 = 38 questions correct.  
To have the highest score, she must get at least 39 correct, because 39/40 = 97.5%, which is higher than 95%.  

Final answer: Sierra
